# Bundled font source

`liberation-fonts-1.07.4.tar.gz` is the unmodified upstream source release for the Liberation Sans fonts bundled by PDF.js 6.4.299. It includes SFD sources, build files, GPLv2 and the Liberation font exception. PaperChat's MIT license does not replace these font licenses.

Upstream source: https://releases.pagure.org/liberation-fonts/liberation-fonts-1.07.4.tar.gz

Upstream version reference: https://github.com/mozilla/pdf.js/blob/v6.4.299/external/standard_fonts/README.md

SHA-256: `ad98b7498dc2992f7f0868f79b65ce4a720a3acdb63ab3f1f1cb6881117a5406`

The release ZIP includes this source archive and THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.txt alongside the signed app. Keep both with any redistributed package. Updating the bundled fonts requires reviewing their matching sources and licenses.
